en.t: I was still a young girl.

units.source_text: 在我前半生所写的信中，最不可思议的是雪天写的信。

en.t: Of all the letters I wrote in the first half of my life, the most extraordinary was the one I wrote on a snowy day.

units.source_text: 现在我再没有力量写第二次了，

en.t: Now I no longer have the strength to write it a second time,

units.source_text: 它将成为令人怀念的回忆。

en.t: and it will become a memory to look back on with longing.
